description: This is a satellite orthophoto from the Spot 5 sensor, dated 2012-08-22, depicting a coastal area identified as Sudersand, Sweden. The image, captured at 2.5m resolution using a 1/2/3 band combination, shows a large expanse of dark blue water (sea) in the lower foreground. A bright, light-coloured, curving strip runs along the coastline, representing a sand beach. Inland, behind the beach, is a blurry reddish-brown area indicative of land cover, likely a mix of urban development and vegetation. A small green marker dot is visible on the beach, near the center of the image. The image credits are CNES 2011© and Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image.
